design.common: Retain G02.var01 two-position explicit failure modes and three scheduled missions; extend horizon and collections to 60 hours; enable global PM for every arm.
design.no-pm: No MaterielPM, PMLocation or TaskBreakDown rows.
design.pos-a-only: One CALHOURS 24-hour, one-hour PM bound to POS-A, with a complete Tasks/SubTaskType/TaskBreakDown definition and direct system maintenance at BASE-01.
design.pos-b-only: One CALHOURS 36-hour, half-hour PM bound to POS-B, with a complete Tasks/SubTaskType/TaskBreakDown definition and direct system maintenance at BASE-01.
design.both: Both separately identified position-bound PM tasks.

predeclared_acceptance: All four frozen inputs import and export exactly across every populated business table, with no native conversion error.
The no-pm control produces no PM task event; each single-position arm logs its specified PMID; the combined arm logs both PMIDs in the first-replication event log.
Native report System and Stock bins align to the half-hour collection grid and reconcile PM task counts where exposed.
All run source hashes, invocation, GUI continuity and raw output files are SHA-256 sealed, then independently replayed without author-code imports.

excluded_diagnostics.reason: First source-bound control used the earlier incomplete PM builder; excluded after the builder changed.
Earlier incomplete PM input omitted Tasks and SubTaskType; native converter returned TaskBreakDown and PMLocation #2010. Excluded from acceptance.

limits: A fixed seed with one native replication does not estimate PM population frequencies.
The inherited explicit failure modes can affect task timing; due-time hypotheses are descriptive, not acceptance gates.
This does not establish QTYPM or ENVF propagation for PM, replacement multiplicity, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
